name: web-cream-education-platform-landing-page-yellow-accents
title: Cream Education Landing Page with Yellow Cards
whatItIs: A long cream landing page with a black-outlined nav, hero with a portrait in an arch shape and yellow rating cards, stats, outlined course cards, pastel category tiles, mentor cards, yellow testimonials, blog cards and a footer.
whatItMeans: Black outlines with pastel and yellow fills give a playful neo-brutalist feel that is friendly for learning.
techniques: Thick black outlines on all cards
Portrait in an arch with a yellow outline
Pastel tiles per category with icon badges

vocabulary.definition: A card defined by a bold border rather than a shadow.
A photo masked into a rounded-top arch.
A coloured card representing a course category.
